title: Informant & Takeel
gameText: USED: If a battle was just initiated at same site as your Undercover spy, your characters at adjacent sites may move there as a 'react' (for free). OR Cancel Sabotage. LOST: If both players just drew one battle destiny, use 1 Force to switch numbers.
evidence: Full remaster viewed: destiny5, unrestricted Used or Lost, no credit circles/EpisodeI. Approved Undercover capitalized.

title: Cold Feet & He Hasn't Come Back Yet
gameText: Target a character at any marker site. Draw destiny. If total destiny > ability, character may not move for remainder of turn. OR During your control phase, target any character alone at one of your exterior planet sites (except a docking bay). Draw destiny. Target is missing if destiny +3 > ability.
evidence: Full remaster viewed: destiny3 Lost unrestricted, no credits/EpisodeI. Cold Feet nighttime bonus omitted by printed RG text.

title: Presence Of The Force & Dark Waters
gameText: Deploy on any exterior planet site (except Hoth) to add one [Dark] and one [Light]. Opponent's Force drains are -1 here. (Immune to Alter when a swamp creature is present.)
evidence: Full remaster viewed: two uniqueness dots, destiny2 Effect, no credits/EpisodeI; only exterior planet site except Hoth.

title: Force Lightning & Rise, My Friend
gameText: Target any character (even a captive) present with Emperor. USED: Target is defense value -4 for remainder of turn. LOST: Emperor loses immunity to attrition and is defense value -2 for remainder of turn. Draw Destiny. Target lost if destiny +1 > defense value. OR If Emperor on Death Star II, take Vader into hand from a location you control (cards on him go to owner's hand).
evidence: Full image viewed: unique destiny4 Used-or-Lost, no credits/EpisodeI; no Rise relocation or Sense immunity.

title: Well Guarded & Security Precautions
gameText: Deploy on table. If you 'probe' opponent's "Hidden Base" system, opponent loses X Force, where X = 15 - number of systems on table. You take no battle damage where you have a 'probe' card. Also, while you have fewer than 13 cards in your hand, your non-unique cards in hand (except effects of any kind and any interrupts) are immune to Grimtaash. (Immune to Alter while you occupy 2 battlegrounds).
evidence: Full remaster rechecked: unique destiny4, no credits/EpisodeI; table deployment and conditional Alter immunity. Earlier visual read of3 was corrected before tests/publication.

title: Your Destiny & Insignificant Rebellion
gameText: Deploy on Bring Him Before Me. When Vader is present at a battleground site, at start of your turn opponent loses 3 Force unless Luke is captured, out of play or present at a battleground site. Luke is immune to Responsibility Of Command. Also, each time you win a battle, opponent loses 1 Force (cannot be reduced) and stacks lost card here face down. When attempting to cross Luke over (except with Epic Duel), add 3 to total destiny for each card in stack. (Immune to Alter.)
evidence: Full image viewed: unique destiny0 Effect, no credits/EpisodeI; deploy on Bring Him Before Me; no 2Force cost.

title: Emperor's Power & Overseeing It Personally
gameText: Deploy on your Throne Room. You may not Force drain here. While Emperor here, opponent's characters are deploy +2 to Death Star II sites and, once per turn, you may lose Effect (or 1 Force from top of Reserve Deck) to add one battle destiny anywhere. Also, while Emperor is at a battleground planet site you control, at each related site where an Imperial is present, your Force drains are +1. Effect lost if Emperor lost from table. (Immune to Alter.)
evidence: Full image viewed: unique destiny3 Effect, no credits/EpisodeI; attached to own Throne Room; lost if Emperor lost from table.
